findings.namedBuyers: Two verified owner-side relationship candidates are Dra. Olynka Vega Vega, 2026 IMIN President, and Dr. Juan Carlos Ramírez Sandoval, 2026 Secretary. Their board roles make them relevant for referral to congress operations and the accommodation decision-maker; neither is verified as hotel-contract signatory. IMIN publishes imin@imin.org.mx and +52 55 5485 9886 as organization-level routes, not their personal contacts.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed within the requested horizon: Semana IMIN runs 17–21 November 2026, not publication dates. Actualízame runs 17–18 November; congress inauguration is 18 November and the congress programme is dated 18–21 November. As of 14 November this is upcoming, not expired. No verified 2027 or January–May 2028 edition date or destination was located; recurrence must not be converted into a confirmed future booking.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel profile: Sheraton Guadalajara Expo’s 216 guestrooms and meetings capability could support a limited faculty, exhibitor or delegate lodging allocation and small ancillary meetings, if requested. However this congress is at Hard Rock, not Expo Guadalajara, so Expo adjacency does not establish walkable event access or a venue advantage. Transport and total delivered cost need assessment. The documented city/convention-centre and city-hotel editions support an urban meetings proposition; no resort requirement is evidenced. Do not assume this hotel can host the full congress.
findings.venueCommitments: The organizer names Hotel Hard Rock Guadalajara as the 2026 sede, Av. Ignacio L Vallarta 5145, Camino Real, Zapopan, Jalisco. Published programmes also name Hard Rock meeting rooms. This establishes an announced venue commitment, not access to its private contract. No Expo Guadalajara venue commitment is shown.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified timeline: 2023 Expo Santa Fe, Mexico City; 2024 Mexico City, 3–7 December; 2025 Mérida, Centro Internacional de Congresos de Yucatán, 3–6 December; 2026 Hard Rock Guadalajara, 17–21 November. The archived 2024/2025 pages contain conflicting Mazatlán venue/template material; the 2024 post-event institutional report and 2025 welcome plus participant report take precedence. A fixed rotation or resort preference is not established.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel sourcing status: UNKNOWN for additional suppliers; main venue already confirmed. The official page lists Hard Rock, Camino Real and Malibú. Malibú directs attendees to book mentioning CONGRESO IMIN - NOV 2026, without a special code; its flyer gives mcasillas@hotelmalibu.com.mx, +52 33 3880 5660 ext. 1666 and WhatsApp +52 33 1659 2121. Its rate requires a minimum 10 rooms and is subject to availability/pre-booking: a rate condition, not proof of 10 rooms booked or event demand. Camino Real’s linked flyer says 5–13 September 2026 with a 4 September reservation deadline, inconsistent with November; do not treat those rates as verified for the event. No public accommodation RFP, room-block allocation or additional-hotel invitation was found.
findings.organizationStructure: Event owner/organizer is Instituto Mexicano de Investigaciones Nefrológicas A.C., a nonprofit scientific/professional organization founded in 1970, not the hotel. Integra Meetings, SA de CV is identified as the SEMANA IMIN app developer/provider; this is evidence of a digital-service relationship only, not evidence that it is the PCO, accommodation buyer or contract controller. No sourcing mandate for a PCO/DMC was verified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Hard Rock has the main venue advantage and publishes double-room prices of MXN 2,400, 2,800 and 3,200 by category. Malibú publishes a standard 1–2 adult rate of MXN 1,780 per room/night including buffet breakfast and taxes for 17–21 November. Camino Real is also listed but its linked validity dates conflict. Multiple listed hotels establish an existing accommodation network, NOT sell-out, overflow, unmet demand or open inventory. Hybrid attendance also prevents converting attendance into hotel-room demand.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Recommended now: call IMIN at +52 55 5485 9886 and send a short introduction to imin@imin.org.mx, addressed to Olynka Vega Vega and Juan Carlos Ramírez Sandoval. Ask for the operational accommodation buyer, any genuinely unallocated 17–21 November room requirement, stay pattern, budget and transport needs. Only then quote a capped allocation against actual Sheraton availability; do not claim overflow or attempt to displace the announced venue. If no immediate need, request a post-event discussion of the next congress sourcing calendar and Guadalajara eligibility. Final qualification remains with ORS.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: As of 14 November 2026 there are only three days to the programme start. Core meeting-venue capture is not an evidenced opportunity because Hard Rock is already announced. A small last-minute lodging or ancillary-meeting offer is conditional on IMIN confirming unmet requirements; no current overflow or new-supplier sourcing is verified. Individual attendee reservation channels are not a hotel-supplier procurement opening.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: successive 2023–2026 congress editions and changes from Mexico City to Mérida to Guadalajara justify a relationship-led future competitive-capture strategy, not a confirmed Guadalajara repeat. Ask about the 2027/2028 decision calendar, city eligibility and separate lodging versus venue selection before proposing. No future-edition contract, RFP or confirmed date was located.
